title: Uniform trilinear contamination and endpoint audit
objective: Develop and independently audit a pointwise prime-scale upper bound for near-cubic three-factor contamination, and compare the exact endpoint-uniform parity input with the existing deletion obstruction, without weakening the Goldbach objective.
deliverables: Complete candidate proof and dependency map
Independent finite checks with raw results
success_criteria: A claimed uniform bound states its constants and order of limits
Every substantive proof receives a separate critic
Repeated factors and factors dividing N are handled explicitly
Finite arithmetic evidence is not promoted to an unbounded proof
Goldbach is not called solved while the parity-sensitive lower bound is open
stop_conditions: Finish this six-stage tranche within 30 declared proxy units and preserve all failures
No separately billed provider execution or external mutable action
If this tranche leaves the objective open, record the precise missing estimate before continuing another tranche
